column1: # The reference's call surface for the two election seams, captured so the
# frozen traits can be checked against something that is not us.
# 664f58e705 (tag 1.53.2). Every row is one *distinct invocation signature* of
# (side=sender), with the parameter types as the reference declares them in
# ConsensusModuleAgent.java / ConsensusPublisher.java and the call sites in
# sort -u` answers **26 names** — that is where the plan's "26 个方法" comes
# from — but four of those names are Java overload pairs (a getter and a
# setter), so there are **30 distinct signatures across 44 calls**. Rust has no
# overloading, so the trait has 30 methods and the plan's number was a
# name count, not a method count. The sender side has no overloads: 6 names,
# Rust names are the ones the frozen traits use. `set_*` / no-prefix is the
# getter/setter split, which is the only place the mapping is not mechanical.
#   arity         parameter count in the reference (publication included)
#   rust_name     the method on ElectionHost / ConsensusSender
#   params_java   parameter list, reference types, in order
#   calls         how many times Election.java calls it
#   el_lines      the call sites in Election.java
# Regenerate by re-running the extraction below and diffing; do not hand-edit:
# (The extraction is a 30-line script; it is kept out of the repo because the
#  table changes only with a reference bump, and a bump moves more than this.)
